diagnostic_definitions.box_match_quality: mask IoU on the same pair selected by native fixed class-aware box matching
diagnostic_definitions.low_conf_band: 0.001 <= score < 0.25 from standard pass post-NMS predictions
diagnostic_definitions.low_conf_candidate_gt: GT unmatched by native mask matching on the >=0.25 subset of the standard pass, with >=1 same-class mask IoU >=0.50 candidate in the low band
diagnostic_definitions.nonzero_overlap_criterion: box IoU or mask IoU strictly above zero
